content: 4:1-5 Imbigau munon qei munon yamangar wurimurimar qamb igour
Igomurur qau qomon ete oboun end qo dibes qamarei: qen geret munon qei bo me wot oabigunorei. Munon qei sogoin wurinou qob song-song eng wurimurimar qamarari wuritoar igorubour.
Munon eng wurinou misir qo qoyam eng irinei diarau gas ende ebeter end qetopur wurinou qob eng ba dibesiorubour. Ende ebet munon misir ba songesiari qomon uber werei eng maigas me imbigunerei.

Munon yurau eng wuri yamangar me baiar qamb qiyo a mani qei me niar qamb wuri gitatarubour. Ego Qenu mi eng gagar gugum in soro big ebet wonou qob apand eng inimbigar qamb. Mi ba nub wonou unum bereriomun.
Mi gugum Qenu barsier eng aren tor, boru qamb me wogun. Ba nub wot gari uber qas qamb igorun.
Qenu wonou qob eng nob in wo qebi qomorun eng nob mi gugum aba aren tor burab igo.
4:6-16 Pol Timoti sarau ebeiner eng werei imbigorei
Ne qob eng munon banam wurinob qamb eng ne Munon inubersiau tari Yisas wonou sarau munon qoregen igoriban. Ne oabigau qob end mom sig-sig mom nonoguret ne qoyam qei-qei musub imbig toat igoar.
Munon qei yamangar isigi gas ende qob song-song qamarari igub eng, ne mogirt wab wog. Wogub Qenu wonou qomon eng musub qerei imbigiban.

Ne mom imbig igoan eng. Qomon ger tandari ebet igumune initreminer eng git goan sarog buriba. Ego Qenu qomon eng tandari toat igumune initreminer eng qenen git goan sarog big igoruboun. See igom igoun eng ende at igorun eng ten isi yarab qen geret igomot igorun eng imusi ende gari.
Qob eng apand ar, munon gugum igub oabigunor eng uber ar.

Qenu wo munon gugum wuriqubeiamorei. Ne in munon apand wot oabigumin eng inba igusub igo. Qenu bebereg igo end apand wot oabig qoat qo urumet igumune bo inamar iriba. Qanam end in qer omboat qib igoun.
Qob eng nonob quraum eng munon yamangar imbig wurinob qamara toat igorunor.

Wuri ne negounor eng wau moi, eng negab ne munon ar gas ende me nesiorunor. Ne wurinou qugur gas ende igama munon oabig igour eng netoat igorunor. Qob qemerinen end, ne qib igamau end, ne munon wuri toubarau end, ne oabigau qomon end, ne qoregen qib igamau end.
Ye me yarine yoat igo gab eng Qenu qob eng dibes wanungerama munon igari ne qomon qei musub wuriimbiga toat igorunor.
Sios munon barai wuri Qenu qobt ne nemaragansiamir eng noopuri ten igo end ne mein burab me eb.
Qenen ne sarau eng qas ebet igoar. Igama munon gugum nonou sarau eng wuritremba.
Nonou qomon ebeiner eng musub qerei ne munon wuriimbig. Qomon end naget ebeinen eng nonomi musub ne munon qei gor nonou qob eng igari wuritrama sarog big igorubour.
